content: Bidirectional Encoder Representations from Transformer (BERT) BIBREF1 has shown strong ability in semantic reasoning. It was recently proposed and obtained impressive results on many tasks, ranging from text classification, natural language inference, and machine reading comprehension. BERT achieves this by employing two objectives in the pre-training, i.e., the masked language modeling (Masked LM) and the next sentence prediction (NSP). Intuitively, the Masked LM task concerns word-level knowledge, and the NSP task captures the global document-level information. The goal of NSP is to identify whether an input sentence is next to another input sentence. From the ablation study BIBREF1, the NSP task is quite useful for the downstream NLI and MRC tasks (e.g., +3.5% absolute gain on the Question NLI (QNLI) BIBREF2 task).
